sources.title: Qwen3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the dense model architecture in the Qwen3 family, available in sizes from 0.6B to 32B parameters. It supports both thinking mode (multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode, with seamless switching between the two. Qwen3 was trained on approximately 36T tokens covering 119 languages. See also the MoE variant Qwen3MoE.

sources.snippet: Configuration: Qwen3Config Qwen3Config is a @dataclass in qwen3/config.py 15-52 that holds all hyperparameters for a Qwen3 model variant. It is constructed from a HuggingFace config.json via the from_model_dir class method, which reads the JSON and maps field names to the internal naming convention.

sources.title: ConFIG: Towards Conflict-free Training of Physics Informed Neural Networks
sources.snippet: The loss functions of many learning problems contain multiple additive terms that can disagree and yield conflicting update directions. For Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), loss terms on initial/boundary conditions and physics equations are particularly interesting as they are well-established as highly difficult tasks. To improve learning the challenging multi-objective task posed by PINNs, we propose the ConFIG method, which provides conflict-free updates by ensuring a positive dot pr
